info.name: ONEMEP DID Specification (Technical Master → DID)
info.description:
DID tab of the Technical Master (Design Intent & Brief, Delivery Schedule, Client Information, Architect Team, Structure Consultant Team) — ONEMEP-29/31.

HOW TO USE
1. Select an environment (baseUrl / email / password), or edit the collection variable defaults.
2. Run **Auth > Login** first — its test script stores `accessToken` as a collection variable.
3. All other requests inherit Bearer `{{accessToken}}` automatically.
4. Run **Get project by id** or create a project via the main Feature Service collection to populate `projectId`, or just edit the `projectId` variable directly.

All paths go through the API Gateway with the `/feature` and `/identity` prefixes — the gateway rewrites these to each service's real context path (`/feature-service`, `/identity-service`).

ONEMEP-31: Technical Master and DID are one form, saved together through a single action — there is no standalone DID save endpoint. This collection only covers DID's read-only requests (GET); for the combined save, see the "Technical Master" folder in ONEMEP-Feature-Service.postman_collection.json — its "Save Technical Master + DID (combined)" request nests the DID payload under the same `did` field shown in this collection's earlier examples.
